case.summary: This case was triggered by an analyst request monitoring four online purchases totalling $1,926.93 on card C10990-K1 within an hour on 2016-11-21. The graph analysis revealed the same structuring pattern on 11 other cards in the surrounding 30 days, linked by amount and timing only, with no shared device. The verdict is fraud with an initial and final fraud probability of 0.98, supported by threshold structuring indicators and similar prior confirmed fraud cases. Actions taken include an automatically created case, monitoring connected cards, escalating to an analyst, a recommended L1 block card action pending approval, and a recommended L2 file report action pending approval.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details fraudulent online activity involving customer C10990 and card C10990-K1 using a new device with email domain web.de in billing region . On 2016-11-21 between 16:00:00 and 16:24:00, four online purchases were executed in an online channel totaling $1,926.93 ($477.19, $484.81, $468.87, and $496.06). Each transaction was kept just under the $500 threshold within a 24-minute window. This behavior is highly suspicious as the amount $496.06 is well above the card's 90th percentile of $121.60, and identical structuring patterns were identified across 11 other cards (C00466-K1, C01890-K1, C02265-K1, C03633-K1, C05423-K1, C05766-K1, C05851-K1, C06881-K1, C07297-K1, C10751-K1, and C12641-K2) within the surrounding 30 days. The total exposure amounts to $1,926.93. Automated and manual actions were initiated pursuant to policies 3a, R6, and R9, including creating the case (auto), monitoring connected cards (auto), escalating to an analyst (auto), recommending a card block under policy 6 (L1, pending approval), and recommending filing a suspicious activity report due to the coordinated undocumented pattern exceeding $1,000 (L2, pending approval). How the 11 connected card(s) are linked: 11 card(s) show the same structuring pattern (a burst of just-under-$500 online purchases within an hour); the link is amount and timing only. None of them shares a device profile with this card.
